subject: Render legacy sampler guards added; exact factory enable needs device-init owner
body:
Added tegu_sampler_legacy_ok and guards to every legacy sampler consumer in render_encoder.inc: sphere observer, R85 fixed-UI texture snapshot, compositor snapshot, and TGR5 legacy texture path. States with exact N2T state must satisfy tegu_sampler_legacy_word_ok; pre-state objects (only linearFilters existed) stay compatible. Nonlegacy states are now refused/command-error rather than silently reduced on those paths.

The remaining exact-factory hook is compute/device-owned: textures added tegu_sampler_enable_exact_factory(1). It must be called from coherent device/backend initialization when n2mb_draw_v2 and the exact planner are linked, BEFORE first sampler creation, not on first v2 draw. Render can expose a helper if compute wants one, but compute_frontend.m owns device init. Generic path already reads exact state and refuses nonlegacy planning; fixed/compositor are guarded now. No code change requested in render beyond that.
